mathematics: An actual adjacent equal-word edge in a sorted pile gives two distinct labels with the same word.
First factorial moment and exact pile count give total full-word probability mass in pile p equal to np/n.
Second factorial moment plus restricted-word union bound gives small-pile failure at most (k/2)*n^xi*maximalMean.
The terminal maximal-mean bound yields (k/2)*n^(xi-eta) exactly.
public_type_and_model: The event is the frozen pileEdgeFree failure on the actual fixed-count sample.
No independent-row or random-pile law is assumed. smallPileFailure_mean has no mean-bound premise; smallPileFailure is a helper with explicit hmean.
adversarial: n>=2 is used for the second moment. Empty and singleton piles have no edge witness.
Zero word probabilities and impossible words are handled by nonnegative factorial moments.
The terminal margin must be supplied by the proved Margins adapter before final regularityFailure.
remaining: UniformRegularity must discharge hmean from actual empirical terminal margin.
